_meta.indication: TURALIO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT) associated with severe morbidity or functional limitations and not amenable to improvement with surgery.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized (1:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in patients with symptomatic TGCT not amenable to surgical resection.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with symptomatic TGCT (also GCT-TS/PVNS) for whom surgical removal of the tumor would be associated with worsening functional limitation or severe morbidity.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was ORR at Week 25 by blinded independent central review (BICR) per RECIST v1.1 (proportion achieving CR or PR).
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 38% (95% CI 26%, 50%) with pexidartinib vs 0% (95% CI 0, 6%) with placebo; p<0.0001. DOR ranged 6.9+ to 24.9+ months.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>20%) include increased LDH, increased AST, hair color changes (67%), fatigue (64%), increased ALT, decreased neutrophils, increased cholesterol, increased ALP, and rash. Serious risk is hepatotoxicity: ALT elevations in 67% and AST elevations in 90% of ENLIVEN patients; across 768 treated patients there were two irreversible cases of cholestatic liver injury (one death, one liver transplant).
target_moa: Pexidartinib is a small molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor of CSF1R, KIT, and FLT3-ITD; in vitro it inhibited CSF1R, KIT and FLT3 catalytic activity with IC50 values of 0.017, 0.12, and 0.16 umol/L. Inhibiting CSF1R blocks the tumor-driving CSF-1 signaling in TGCT.

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: HEPATOTOXICITY. TURALIO can cause serious and potentially fatal liver injury. Monitor liver tests and withhold/dose reduce or discontinue based on severity; available only through the TURALIO REMS.

rems.type: TURALIO is available only through a restricted program under a REMS because of the risk of hepatotoxicity; prescribers and pharmacies must be certified, and patients must enroll (patient registry).

advisory_committee.vote: ODAC met May 14, 2019 and voted 12 Yes, 3 No, 0 Abstain that the demonstrated benefit of pexidartinib outweighs the risks in the proposed indication.

summary.text: TURALIO received traditional approval under a Priority review for symptomatic TGCT based on the ENLIVEN trial, which showed a statistically significant ORR benefit (38% vs 0%; p<0.0001). Pexidartinib had orphan drug designation for PVNS/GCT-TS. The application was referred to ODAC (voted 12 Yes, 3 No), and approval carries a boxed warning for hepatotoxicity and a mandatory REMS.
